The '''Avenue of the Core Founders''' was a large avenue which served as the ceremonial pathway to the [[Great Door of the Senate|Great Door]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Lined with statues of the original [[Core Founder/Legends|founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Access ways to the [[Senate Commercial District]] were located on the Avenue.

==History==
Constructed around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the huge avenue bisected the expansive [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]]. Dotted with towering, thirty meter tall impressionistic statues of the all [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] who drafted the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], the avenue was flanked by the [[Garden of Justice|Gardens of Justice]] and [[Garden of Equality|Equality]] on either side. Following the [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on Coruscant by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the final days of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the Avenue of the Core Founders was cleaned up of debris and reopened to the public. Frequented by [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and their aides, lobbyists, petitioners, and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Avenue connected the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], terminating at a transportation terminal.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:CFavenueTOR.png|thumb|left|300px|The Avenue during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]]]
Over the next three millennia, the spaceport was removed and the Avenue expanded. During the final decades of the Republic, mounting opposition to the Avenue's Human-dominated statuary plagued the Senate and the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] as many [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] from the alien-dominated [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rims]] found them to be distasteful and narrow-minded, if not [[Speciesism|speciesist]]. Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] himself publicly stated that diversity should be incorporated into the Avenue's statuary; however, even after being elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], he apparently failed to implement his idea.<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

During the Chancellorship of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], a large protest took place in the Plaza, with vocal citizens lining the Avenue; some called for the dissolution of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], others for the retirement of the Chancellor for his ineffectual trade policies. As [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Valorum made his exit from the Senate Building through the crowd of protesters on the Avenue, a band of terrorists attacked him and his contingent of [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]]. While the Chancellor sustained injury, the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] prevented his death and the terrorists were routed.<ref name="COD" />

Following the fall of the Republic and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Avenue continued to serve as the main road to the Senate, even after the building's closure during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Years after the Empire's dissolution, the Avenue was ruined during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]] as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy. Under Yuuzhan Vong control, the Avenue became home to a massive and deadly [[hedge maze]] designed to keep intruders out of the newly christened [[Well of the World Brain|Well]] of the [[World Brain]]. Despite the destruction of the Avenue, at least one of the large impressionistic statues survived; it was at one point owned by a group of [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
